headline: Solar Panel Requirement for New Buildings Raises Concerns; Ministries of Economic Affairs and Interior Abruptly Revise Standards Without Notice - Politics
summary: Standards requiring solar photovoltaic equipment on new buildings of 1,000 square meters or more, originally due August 1, were revised by the Ministries of Economic Affairs and Interior. Concerns were raised over the lack of notice.
why: Mandatory solar requirements affect construction costs and demand for solar equipment in Taiwan. Changes to building standards are relevant to developers and renewable energy suppliers.
